summary: Iteration 16 tested the fix for the Dashboard Cash & Bank row that stayed on Loading forever. Backend: /summary/party/{id} now falls back to the accounts collection and returns kind=account, group CASH & BANK BALANCE and bills/rokad/dos_journal as []. Its balance matches the accounts-summary closing and /ledgers/{id}/balance, and the opening with date_from matches the accounts-summary opening. The rows add up to the closing, entries stay inside the date range, the party-kind regression passes, unknown ids return 404 'Party / account nahi mila' and unauthenticated calls return 401. Frontend: clicking the account row opens the ledger header 'Account Ledger · CASH & BANK BALANCE' with balance 52,90,000 Dr and the back link pointing to /accounts. The party row opens 'Party Khata · Ledger' with the back link pointing to /parties. The date controls, Statement toggle, error card + retry, bill-view error, Party Khata list -> ledger and Settings all work, with no page errors. Failures: validation for impossible dates only checks the pattern, so the requested as_on=2026-13-99 -> 400 check fails (returns 200), and date_from=2026-13-99 returns 500.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 400. The regex \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} accepts dates that do not exist, and the bad string is used as-is in the date comparison. The review request expected 400.
500 Internal Server Error: datetime.fromisoformat raises ValueError (in party_ledger / _account_ledger).
Returns 200 because it uses the same regex-only validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Every 404 shows 'Yeh khata nahi mila — shayad delete ho gaya hai.', so the /bills/does-not-exist page says 'khata' (ledger) instead of 'bill'. The 404 message should be a prop, e.g. notFoundText.

issues: Transaction rows show dates in ISO format (2026-10-14) while the opening/closing rows and the statement use DD-MM-YYYY. This is older behaviour, not part of this fix.

action_items: Add a shared date validator that parses with datetime.date.fromisoformat inside try/except and raises HTTPException(400). Use it in party_ledger, ledger_balance, rokad_accounts_summary and the other endpoints that only check the pattern, so impossible dates return 400 and never 500.
Optional: give LoadState a notFoundText prop so BillView/Settings 404s don't say 'khata nahi mila'.
Optional: BillView LoadState has no onRetry, so a network error has no retry button (only the back link).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >2500 lines and should be split into routers (ledger/summary, rokad, accounts).
party_ledger and _account_ledger repeat the date_from -> day_before opening logic; this could move into a small helper.
PartyLedger 'Shuru se' sets from='' in the URL, which works correctly (dateFrom=''), but the URL keeps an empty param.
seed_data_creation: None. All tests were read-only GET calls.
